hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Armor absorbs damage up to its threshold on the single most damaging monster attack.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the total damage inflicted across all monsters.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Subtract min(max_damage, armor) and add one to ensure health never drops to zero.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minInitialStrength(damage: list[int], armor: int) -> int:
    total_dmg = sum(damage)
    max_single = max(damage)
    absorb = min(max_single, armor)
    return total_dmg - absorb + 1
```

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates damage and identifies maximal single blow.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary search is possible but closed-form formula is strictly O(N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scalar accumulators use constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedily applies armor on max damage round and derives minimum starting health.
